item.title: VIA DOLORIS Announce Debut Album “Guerre et Paix”, Out March 20th
item.description: Via Doloris is rooted in an inward journey rather than orthodoxy. Conceived in solitude and shaped by discipline, composer and multi-instrumentalist Gildas Le Pape traces a restrained and introspective path through black metal’s formal foundations, guided by melody, atmosphere and emotional clarity. item.title: HARMS Sign to Time To Kill Records for Release of Upcoming Second Full-Length Album “Rebirth of the Cold”
item.description: Finnish purveyors of atmospheric heaviness HARMS have officially signed with Time To Kill Records for the release of their upcoming second full-length album, “Rebirth of the Cold”, with further details to be unveiled in the coming months. item.title: YOUR INLAND EMPIRE Release Searing New Video for ‘Edge of Perfection’
item.description: From the ashes of Crown, rises a dark new wave of industrial rock. item.title: RAIN DIARY Release New Single ‘Naive’ from Upcoming Album “Night Church”
item.description: The best-kept secret of the Finnish gothic rock scene, Rain Diary, released their new single Naive yesterday, January 22, 2026.
